description: This plot illustrates the training loss curves for various model configurations in a post-training setting. The x-axis, labeled "#Iteration", employs a linear scale ranging from roughly 92,500 to 130,000, with numeric tick marks evenly spaced at intervals of 5000. The y-axis, labeled "Loss", also uses a linear scale with a displayed range from 2.0 to 3.0 and tick intervals of 0.2. There are four lines represented in the plot, three of which are solid, have no markers, and are surrounded by a lighter, semi-transparent shaded region of the same color. The solid pink line, labeled "SepLLM (n=64, larger lr)", begins off-chart above 3.0 near iteration 95000, exhibits a steep initial decline, crosses a y-value of 2.6 around iteration 97500, and gradually slows its descent to end at approximately 2.22 near iteration 127500. The solid dark blue line, denoting "SepLLM (n=128)", similarly starts above 3.0, drops steeply to cross 2.6 near iteration 100000, and continues a steady decline to finish at roughly 2.28 at the end of the x-axis. The solid orange line representing "SepLLM (n=64)" tracks slightly above the dark blue line throughout the plot; it features a distinct, sharp spike just above 2.6 near iteration 100500, after which it resumes a smooth decline, ending at approximately 2.30. Finally, the "Vanilla before post-training" condition is depicted as a red dashed line with no markers or shading, maintaining a constant horizontal trajectory at a y-value of exactly 2.35 across the entire range of iterations.
